name: vague-description
description: >-
  A comprehensive, powerful and flexible toolkit for working with changelogs in
  software repositories of every size. It supports many popular changelog
  formats, including Keep a Changelog, conventional commits, flat bullet lists
  and free-form prose, and it understands semantic versioning, calendar
  versioning and custom schemes. It can read existing changelog files, parse
  their structure, detect the format automatically, and report problems such
  as missing dates, duplicated versions, unsorted entries, broken links and
  inconsistent heading levels. It can also draft new entries from a list of
  merged pull requests, group changes by type, highlight breaking changes,
  suggest a version number, and keep the wording consistent with earlier
  entries. It works with monorepos, supports multiple packages, respects
  existing conventions, and never rewrites history. It integrates with CI,
  produces machine-readable output for other tools, and is designed to be fast,
  reliable and easy to extend with new formats and rules in the future.
---
